snippet.title: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
A new trailer for Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree dug into the gameplay loop underpinning this anime action roguelite. It's coming to PC and consoles on September 19, 2025, but you can play the demo now across all major platforms.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #towaandtheguardians
